gloss: swing and a miss; fruitless effort

definitions.explanation: swinging the bat but failing to make contact with the ball
an action that fails to achieve its intended result

examples.japanese: {空振|からぶ}り{三振|さんしん}に{終|お}わった。
{変化球|へんかきゅう}に{空振|からぶ}りした。
examples.english: He swung and missed at the breaking ball.

examples.japanese: バッターが{大|おお}きく{空振|からぶ}りした。
examples.english: The batter took a big swing and missed.

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}が{空振|からぶ}りに{終|お}わった。
examples.english: The plan ended up being a wasted effort.

examples.japanese: {営業|えいぎょう}が{空振|からぶ}りばかりだ。
examples.english: My sales calls keep coming up empty.

examples.japanese: {取材|しゅざい}が{空振|からぶ}りに{終|お}わった。

notes:
BASEBALL TERM:
{空振|からぶ}り combines {空|から} (empty) + {振|ふ}り (swinging). Originally baseball terminology that has extended to figurative use.

BASEBALL CONTEXT:
- {空振|からぶ}りストライク - swinging strike
- {空振|からぶ}り{三振|さんしん} - strikeout swinging
- {大|おお}きく{空振|からぶ}り - big swing and miss

USAGE:
The term is commonly used figuratively to mean any action that fails to achieve results:
- {空振|からぶ}りに{終|お}わる - to end up fruitless
- {空振|からぶ}りばかり - nothing but failed attempts

RELATED WORDS:
- {三振|さんしん} - strikeout
- {見逃|みのが}し - called strike (not swinging)
- {凡打|ぼんだ} - weak hit/ground out
